subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require real Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before accepting this session-state timing change?
rationale: The source-level fix is plausible and focused, but the external PR proof does not exercise the reported user-visible transport or a production runner path.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on source and focused test evidence, while owning that the reported Feishu path was not proven on the PR head.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical Feishu issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 if no one can produce transport or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the wait-for-idle-before-flush helper that defines the cleanup boundary this PR changes.
